author: Tynvale
body:
Don't be fooled, unfortunately I am not returning to Avicus, but instead to Youtube. Since most of my subscribers came from this amazing server a couple of years ago, I thought I would post this to notify people of the return as everytime I visit I am asked if I would start again; well now I am.

The video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l34S3HtS-Yo

Hopefully you can forgive me for taking such a long break, and making this kinda selfish post.
